event_chain.summary: Employee abused access to take customer data

summary: Dutch energy supplier Innova Energie emailed customers of its subsidiary Gewoon Energie in March 2026 to say that an employee had unlawfully obtained customer data, including full names, gender, dates of birth, home addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, correspondence history and IBANs. The employee was fired on the spot, and the company reported the breach to the Dutch data protection authority and the Public Prosecution Service. The number of customers affected was not disclosed, and the company said it could not rule out misuse.
